mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of my GEO content strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure success, track local search rankings for geo-targeted keywords, website traffic from local searches, and Google My Business insights like map views, search queries, and calls. Monitor conversion rates from local traffic, such as local lead form submissions or store visits. Review the number and sentiment of local online reviews, and track local citation consistency. These metrics provide a clear picture of how well your content is performing in attracting and converting local customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track local search rankings, website traffic from local searches, Google My Business insights, local conversion rates, and local online reviews. These metrics show your GEO content's effectiveness.
